## Description
Brief description of changes made.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / optimization
- [ ] Build/CI changes

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Tested on WordPress 6.7+
- [ ] Tested with PHP 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3
- [ ] Tested with WooCommerce (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested with default WordPress theme (Twenty Twenty-Four)
- [ ] Tested with popular themes (Astra, GeneratePress, etc.)
- [ ] No PHP errors/warnings/notices
- [ ] No JavaScript console errors
- [ ] Reading progress bar works correctly
- [ ] View counter works correctly
- [ ] Admin settings save/load properly
- [ ] Translations work (if changed)

## Screenshots / Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings demonstrating the changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the WordPress Coding Standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (readme.txt)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
